The series-create date preview now renders at most 50 chips, with
show-next-50 / show-all-N controls (two new keys, four locales).
The count line keeps showing the full total; month groupings
survive partial reveal; the reveal state resets to the first 50
whenever the generated set changes (keyed off the candidate set —
